page: UpCloud PREMIUM-32xCPU-64GB is a compute-focused cloud server configured with 32 x86_64 virtual CPU cores based on the AMD EPYC 9575F processor running at a base clock of 2.0 GHz. Deployed on a KVM hypervisor with shared CPU scheduling, each assigned vCPU maps to a physical core running a single thread. The configuration includes 64.0 GB of memory, equating to 2.0 GB per core, alongside 400 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a complimentary public IPv4 address. Architectural support extends to vector acceleration via AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16) and cryptographic acceleration through AES, VAES, and SHA-NI instruction sets.

Benchmark testing indicates exceptional raw processing capabilities, with stress-ng single-core throughput placing in the top 10 percent of evaluated instances. Multi-core execution via stress-ng, PassMark CPU benchmarks, and Geekbench multi-core workloads consistently rank in the top quartile. High single-threaded decompression and text processing metrics highlight solid computational efficiency across text and archive manipulations. However, synthetic memory metrics show variation: cached memory read bandwidth is robust, whereas unbuffered write speeds and PassMark memory benchmarks fall into lower distribution bands, indicating potential memory subsystem saturation under intense write cycles.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides dense thread allocation and bundled fast storage without requiring external block-device attachments. The 1:2 core-to-memory ratio prioritizes compute throughput over memory footprint, making it suitable for multi-threaded compilation, backend processing, parallel batch computing, and high-throughput Redis caching layers.
description: UpCloud PREMIUM-32xCPU-64GB is a compute-focused instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor delivering 32 vCPUs and 32 physical cores across an x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core, alongside 400 GB of integrated local SSD storage and one routed IPv4 address. The CPU incorporates modern vector and cryptographic instruction sets, including AVX-512 and VAES. In benchmark testing, the platform achieves top-tier results in single-threaded stress testing and ranks in the upper quartile for multi-core compute, Geekbench scores, and Redis operations. Although memory write bandwidth displays average throughput, the compute density and integrated local storage deliver substantial parallel processing capacity. UpCloud PREMIUM-32xCPU-64GB is well suited for CPU-intensive batch jobs, software compilation, database caching layers, and high-concurrency backend services.
